svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm PVC foam board, 528 wide x 218 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 81 holes for the fan inlets, centred 150 left and 150 right of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre, 94 up from the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark each fan's four mounting holes through the fan itself; drill 5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and fit rubber grommets so the fans do not drum on the board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the floor lining, its room-side face 94 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside of the room end (78 from the end lining), glued to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side linings. Drawn as seen from outdoors.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The supply fan (right) goes on the room side, its inlet through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole; the exhaust fan (left) goes on the core side, its inlet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the hole facing the room. M4 nylon screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each fan ring sits in its hole with about 0.5 mm all round.
